title: SIL2 certified controllers
content:
Hi,

We are planning to use SIL2 certified controllers in one of our design. Below are few queries from my end which i request your support

  1. From details available in internet, i came to know that no standalone controllers with SIL2 certified. Is that correct?
  2. STM provides Safety SW packages to achieve SIL2 & SIL3. Is that correct?
  3. Which series of controllers STM recommends to use along with Safety SW to achieve SIL2 or 3?
  4. We planned to use STM32U series? Will that be fine along with Safety SW package?
  5. Is the safety SW packages are open source (Free to use) or need to be paid?
  6. If any series STM recommends to use; i need evaluation boards and links where i can order from

 

Thanks

Arfaj

scraped_replies.html:
Hi ​@arfaj,

Welcome to our Community!

This presentation should help you getting answers to your questions stm32_stm8_functional-safety-packages.pdf.

I also invite you to use our Sidekick agent (Ask AI) who can help you to get answers from our documentation.

-Amel
